channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Usage for Claude + ChatGPT 4.0 — Claude + ChatGPT limits on your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch
item.description: A "Performing security verification" CAPTCHA page is all that loads in place of the promised breakdown of Claude and ChatGPT 4.0 usage limits across Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Apollo economist says AI has "no economic payoff" for most businesses
item.description: Apollo economist argues that despite massive AI investment and widespread hype, corporate America outside the tech sector has seen zero financial payoff, highlighting the gap between AI spending and returns. (techcrunch.com)

item.title: patchy631/ai-engineering-hub — In-depth tutorials on LLMs, RAGs and real-world AI agent applications.
item.description: patchy631/ai-engineering-hub gathers in-depth LLM, RAG and real-world AI agent tutorials tiered from beginner to researcher, spanning single- and multi-component agentic workflows, fine-tuning and production deployment, plus a free 150+ lesson Data Science eBook. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: telemetry.dev — Observability for AI agents
item.description: The telemetry.dev page titled "Observability for AI agents" returns only a "Performing security verification" CAPTCHA prompt, so readers get no actual information on AI agent observability. (Product Hunt)

item.title: It’s not AI that reverses a proton’s charge
item.description: Proton CEO Andy Yen dismissed an engineer's request for a few days of penetration testing before shipping as "loser thinking" and tied AI use to employee retention, raising why security guardrails at a privacy company are treated as a burden. (blog.raed.dev)

item.title: Minecraft's AI agent colony fails to build a civilization, getting mired in bureaucracy instead
item.description: A Minecraft experiment in which AI agents attempted to build a civilization failed, with the agents bogged down in bureaucracy, in a test meant to offer insight into recent AI agent headlines. (www.tomshardware.com)

item.title: The AI Cost of JavaScript Frameworks
item.description: Nolan Lawson benchmarks JavaScript frameworks by having each generate a Pokémon app through MCP with Opus 5.5, then measures Lighthouse performance and accessibility to test agent-friendliness. (nolanlawson.com)

item.title: Brazilian Court Sanctions Lawyers for Prompt Injection in Court Filing
item.description: A Brazilian labor court fined two lawyers about $16,000 for hiding a white-on-white prompt injection in a filing that told the court’s Galileu AI to go easy on their case, possibly the first such judicial ruling.
